culprit_citations.quoted_text: Financiere N (dba Nemera) row has Par currency EUR, while Cost and Fair Value columns are explicitly dollar-denominated: Cost $ 12,799; Fair Value $ 13,296.

rationale: FX03 is a Class 1 single-cell currency validation. The flagged stored cost_currency is U_EUR, but the raw schedule table header separates Par from Cost/Fair Value, and row 4 shows EUR only in the Par currency position while the Cost column is marked with a dollar sign. The validator is correctly flagging a valuation field carrying the par currency instead of USD. This is a localized extraction gap, not a false alarm.
